description: Spend from your yield (Aave v3 or Moonwell) with ONE EIP-712 signature: Robyn pulls only up to your on-chain aUSDC/mUSDC allowance, unwinds exactly what is needed, and delivers gaslessly; the remainder keeps earning. This HOSTED endpoint is READ-ONLY: it returns the exact EIP-712 intent to sign + a live quote. To execute, sign it and POST {intent,signature,live:true} to /svc/api/ncaccount/spend, or run `npx anygas-mcp` locally with ROBYN_SIGNER_KEY. One-time setup: supply USDC to Aave v3 or Moonwell in your wallet + approve the relayer for your aUSDC/mUSDC up to your risk budget.
name: robyn_yield_spend
title: Spend from yield (one signature)
